patterns.note: The page uses a dark, full-width design with sections predominantly featuring large, centered headlines, followed by content arranged in two or three-column grids for features and testimonials.

A striking, large-scale serif typeface is used for primary headlines and the brand name, providing a classic, editorial feel that contrasts with a clean sans-serif for body text and functional UI labels.
A dark, almost black background serves as the primary canvas, against which a vibrant teal/cyan is used sparingly for accents, interactive elements, and key visual highlights within product mockups.
A 'Watch video' button in the hero section implies an embedded video or modal, and the language support section suggests a horizontal scrolling or animated reveal for the language list.

Sections are clearly delineated by full-width dark backgrounds and distinct large headings, guiding the user through product introduction, features, use cases, mobile integration, pricing, and social proof.

technique_notes: To achieve the dark, sophisticated aesthetic, use a very dark grey or black as the primary background color. Implement subtle noise or pixelated texture overlays to add depth without distracting. Text should be light (white or light grey) for readability. Introduce a single, vibrant accent color (e.g., teal/cyan) for call-to-action buttons, key UI elements within mockups, and subtle highlights.

Establish a strong typographic hierarchy by pairing a large, elegant display serif font for major headings and brand elements with a clean, legible sans-serif for all body text, subheadings, and UI labels. Utilize varied font weights and sizes to emphasize key information and create a clear visual flow.

Integrate high-fidelity, realistic product mockups (e.g., retro microphone device, iPhone screens) directly into the page content. These mockups should feature the accent color prominently within their UI to tie into the brand's palette, and possibly include subtle glow or depth effects to make them pop against the dark background.
